2.

sentences.text: In terms of said award dated 18.07.2013, an amount of Rs. 2,59,200/- was awarded in favour of the injured claimant namely Bashir Ahmad Sofi, although, in the judgment dated 20.07.2023, this Court has referred to the total compensation so awarded to be Rs. 2,64,200/-.

3. Be that as it may, at the time of institution of the appeal, statutory deposit of Rs. 25,000/- is said to have been made by the appellant- Bilal Ahmad Channa for the sake of maintaining the appeal in terms of requirement of section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988.

10.02.2025 1.
By virtue of a judgment dated 20.07.2023, this Court came to dispose of an appeal CMAM No.
191/2013 filed under section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 whereby an award dated 18.07.2013 passed by Motor Accident Claim Tribunal, MACT Baramulla was challenged at the instance of the driver of the offending vehicle.
2.
opennyai_summary.decision:
In terms of said award dated 18.07.2013, an amount of Rs. 2,59,200/- was awarded in favour of the injured claimant namely Bashir Ahmad Sofi, although, in the judgment dated 20.07.2023, this Court has referred to the total compensation so awarded to be Rs. 2,64,200/-.
3. Be that as it may, at the time of institution of the appeal, statutory deposit of Rs. 25,000/- is said to have been made by the appellant- Bilal Ahmad Channa for the sake of maintaining the appeal in terms of requirement of section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988.
However, before this Court proceeds to dispose of this application, the fact needs to be first confirmed from the Registry and Accounts Section concerned as to whether the statutory deposit of Rs. 25,000/- had taken place at the time of institution, or thereafter, attending the appeal CMAM No. 191/2013 filed by the appellant- Bilal Ahmad Channa.
5. Registry to confirm this fact from the original file of CMAM No. 191/2013 and submit a report on the file for facilitating disposal of the present application.
